usedFor: Authress manages access, and Todoist receives a task through “Create Task” each time “New Connections” reports a connection.

bestTemplate.name: “New Connections” in Authress, then “Create Task” in Todoist
bestTemplate.why: A new connection becomes a task with a title and details, so someone reviews the access change.

watchOut: “New Connections” in Authress is polling, so the Todoist task appears after a scheduled check.
